intent_anchor.user_goal: Deliver dependable Private Reality persistence through the installed-subagent workflow.
intent_anchor.current_priority: Verify signed-journal integrity, runtime mount and authority gating before G4 acceptance.

claim_under_review: G4-001 Correction 001 resolves the runtime and signed-journal blockers.
what_i_accept: Independent persistence smoke passes 22 checks with clean logs.
HMAC-SHA256 seals use an injected key provider and no production key is hardcoded.
Wrong-key, modified, removed, reordered and broken-chain journals fail closed.
Integrated boot registers PersistModule and does not mount AgentPersistStub.
Only confirmed offline Private Reality operations pass the consumer gate; rejected G3 and online/shared/economy operations do not journal locally.
All correction receipts validate against MAF and no writer conflict exists.
what_i_challenge: The smoke key is deterministic and test-only; production device-key provisioning remains an operational concern.
Local signatures remain reconciliation evidence, never server or Shared District authority.
strongest_counter_argument: A device-local key can be controlled by the device owner, so its HMAC proves journal continuity for reconciliation but not canonical multiplayer truth.
missing_evidence: Production key lifecycle and server reconciliation remain future deployment concerns.
The installed adversarial-review skill references absent schema files, so this object follows its documented fields but could not be schema-validated.
blind_spots: Real server reconciliation and key recovery are not claimed by G4.
next_action: Dispatch provider-neutral Paid AGM gateway work without selecting a provider or exposing credentials.
